title: GhostMesh
tagline: Private, flexible cross-chain strategies powered by 1inch’s programmable infrastructure
description:
Cross-Chain Strategy Execution: By leveraging the flexibility of 1inch’s infrastructure, our protocol enables users to implement customized cross-chain strategies through a single, automated transaction. Beyond simple asset swaps, users can define complex workflows—such as arbitrage, rebalancing, or liquidity migration—executed seamlessly across multiple blockchains without manual intervention.

Privacy-Preserving Operations: Our built-in privacy layer ensures that every operation—whether a trade, transfer, or strategy execution—remains confidential. This protects sensitive strategy data from being exposed on-chain, helping users maintain a competitive edge and shielding them from front-running or other forms of adversarial analysis.
how_its_made:
1. leveraging 1inch limited order and cross-chain infrastructure(related with resolver how to complete the cross-chain order)
2.Before user submit order, user can specify which strategies will execute on the target chain. such as lending the returned token in the compound. 
3. User should also submit the proof, which as the evidence for the future operations in the target chain. for example, when the strategies executed by the middle-contract(this contract aims for breaking the relationships between user and the strategies) in the target chain, the address holding the related proof can withdraw the yields from the compound.
